oil.when: 2009 with the message center SETUP and RESET controls
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Press SETUP once to enter the system check, then press SETUP again until the display shows OIL LIFE = XXX% HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. The display shows OIL LIFE SET TO 100%.
oil.note: Tapping RESET while OIL LIFE SET TO 100% is showing lowers the starting value 10% per tap. Leave it at 100% unless your shop advised otherwise.

notes: The 2008–2009 Sable is a twin of the Ford Taurus of the same years.
